value.rationale: The object is the natural four-modal expansion of the upset algebra of a finite Gödel chain, with arbitrary accessibility. Determining the number of distinct operator structures and the size of their observational fibres is an intrinsic finite-model identifiability question, not an arbitrary selected small case. The complete all-n profile criterion, sharp two-to-three-world injectivity boundary, sharp 2n sparsity, explicit lower bound on information loss for all n>=4, and exact n<=5 counts give both structure and numerically nontrivial quantitative answers. No paper-sized general all-n counting formula or downstream theorem is claimed or needed.
